front.description: Independent blogs from around the world, each in its own language, with their titles translated into yours.
front.hero: A confluence of {count, plural, one {# independent blog.} other {# independent blogs.}}
front.intro: Tela channels blogs and personal sites from around the world into one ocean of ideas, translated into Chinese or English as you read.
front.week: This week, {blogs, plural, one {# blog} other {# blogs}} wrote in {languages, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}}
front.latest: The latest from {n, plural, one {# blog} other {# blogs}}
front.empty: No posts yet. The blogs Tela gathers will show here as they write.

writers.title: Write a blog? Make it your calling card.
writers.intro: Claim your blog on Tela and get a page with your name, your blog and the posts you recommend. Your site stays where it is.

login.title: Welcome back
login.intro: Log in to pick up where you left off.

join.title: Join Tela
join.intro: Subscribe to any blog, in any language. No ads, and you can export your subscriptions whenever you like.

door.noCode: No code? Tela is invite-only for now: ask a member for one.

discover.title: Independent blogs, in any language.
discover.intro: Blogs and personal websites with a feed, chosen by Tela, by their writers and by readers. Subscribe in one click; Tela translates as you read.

discover.empty: No blogs listed here yet. Claim yours to be the first.

claim.intro: Claim your feed to see how many read you, how your posts landed, and what readers said recommending them.

hero.title: Your calling card as an independent writer.
hero.lede: One page on Tela with your name, the blogs you write and the posts you recommend. Readers find you there, follow you, and subscribe to your blog in one click.

availability.none: Your handle comes from your name, or your blog's.

member.intro: You're on Tela. Claim your blog to put it on your card.

card.later: Your recommendations, and the blogs you read if you choose to show them, appear here as you use Tela.
card.bioLater: A line about what you write. You can change it any time.
card.captionSample: An example card. Type your name to see yours.

find.title: Writers find each other here.
find.intro: Follow the writers you like and see what they recommend and like, and the blogs they read when they show them. A post someone recommends reaches everyone who follows them, with their note.
find.label: Following · for example

posts.granVia: What you hear on Gran Vía at six in the morning
posts.kitchen: A kitchen you can take with you

link.title: One link for everything you write
link.body: Your card at /@handle lists every blog you claim, with your name and a line about you.

blogroll.title: Your blogroll
blogroll.body: Recommend the posts you liked, with a note. Show the blogs you read as well, if you like: it is one switch in Settings.

readers.title: Readers
readers.body: Readers follow you, subscribe to your blog in one click, and can read it translated beside the original. Your Dashboard shows how many read you, which posts they liked, and the notes they left.
readers.blogReaders: {n, plural, one {# reader} other {# readers}} on Tela

name.title: Pick your name
name.body: Your name, and a handle for your card's address. Both can change later in Settings.

connect.title: Connect your blog
connect.body: Add one line to your site to show it is yours: a meta tag, or a link to your card. Any blog with an RSS or Atom feed works.

follow.title: Follow writers you like
follow.body: Follow other writers and readers: what they recommend shows on your Following page.

nothing.title: Nothing moves
nothing.body: Tela reads the feed you already publish. Every post links back to your site.

ads.title: No ads
ads.body: Tela shows no ads: not next to your writing, and not anywhere else.

translation.title: Translation is yours to turn off
translation.body: Readers can read your posts translated. If you would rather they didn't, turn it off for your blog from the Dashboard.

cta.count: {n, plural, one {# blog is} other {# blogs are}} already on Tela. Where's yours?
cta.title: Where's your blog?

following.subscribed: {n, plural, one {subscribed to} other {subscribed to # blogs, including}}

dashboard.title: Your sites
